[ASSISTANT_CREATED] The training plan includes:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Weeks 1-2: Walking and Running - Start with 2-3 times of walking for 30 minutes each, incorporating short running segments (1-2 minutes) into walks.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Weeks 3-4: Building Endurance - Alternate between walking and running, aiming for 20-30 minutes of total exercise time.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Weeks 5-6: Building Distance - Increase total exercise time to 30-40 minutes, aiming to run for 20-25 minutes without stopping.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Weeks 7-8: Taper and Rest - Reduce exercise time to 20-30 minutes, focusing on active recovery.
